content: Table TABREF8 shows the results of the shared task. All teams receive better results than baseline 1 (FD), of which a total of 8 teams outperform baseline 2 (CNT + CI + CD). The 4 top scores with $\rho $ $>$ 0.7 are either modified versions of SGNS + OP + CD or use SGNS + VI + CD. The following 4 scores in the range of 0.5 $<$ $\rho $ $<$ 0.6 are generated by the models fastText + OP + CD, SGNS + OP + CD/JSD, and PPMI + WI + CD.
